components.mapping_note: GrowthDB curation pass; [CHEM-B12-04] confirmed the existing identity; evidence tier unchanged; [CHEM-B12-04] Exception to CHEM-B12-01. Where the SOURCE itself names Cob(I)alamin, cbl1 is the right target and must not be swept into the dietary-B12 proxy. Scoped away from usda_* because the USDA rows carry "Cob(I)alamin" only as an echo of the BiGG display name the builder wrote over the source nutrient string -- there the name is the pipeline's word, not the source's.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
